mapper.select: SELECT id, entry_date, amount, category, is_proxy_payment, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM expense_entries WHERE entry_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ORDER BY entry_date DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, entry_date, amount, category, is_proxy_payment, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM expense_entries WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expense_entries (entry_date, amount, category, is_proxy_payment, remark) VALUES (#{entryDate}, #{amount}, #{category}, #{proxyPayment}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE expense_entries SET entry_date = #{entryDate}, amount = #{amount}, category = #{category}, is_proxy_payment = #{proxyPayment}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
